notes.notes:
A quick patch to iron out a language issue:
[h3]Bugs[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6.0
notes.notes:
Just a quick update to address some specific problems that have popped up
[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
- fixed gacha ring quest reward
- fixed brians windmill not counting as started if the windmill was already built
- fixed achievement for climbing all mountains

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5.0
notes.notes:
It's my birthday today, so I'm bringing you a fresh new patch!
[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
- Fixed Brians Windmill quest, you can now complete the quest if you built the windmill before taking the quest
- Fixed achievements for minigames
- Fixed various quest rewards

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
- Steamdeck will lower the resolution to the highest possible on deck if appropriate
- Improved some small graphical features

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4.0
notes.notes:
A new patch leaping onto the scene! Some important timer fixes and some smaller dialogue fixes, enjoy!
[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
- Fixed route time only loading the first gold time
- Fixed route timers not resetting
- Fixed various translations and typos
- Fixed all quests achievement
- Fixed radio achievement
- Fixed hand radio input
- Fixed quest rewards not being given

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3.0
notes.notes:
It was long awaited but its here! Get your hopping legs ready because it's time to climb fast!
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
- fixed speed climb times being overwritten
- fixed various achievements
- fixed cursor not showing in menu
- fixed black screen on some minigames
- fixed bone king quest reward
- fixed issues with jetpack and glider
- fixed FOV issues with binoculars
- fixed teleporting during cutscene

[h3]Content[/h3]
- removed a gacha machine due to oversupply of gachas

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
- added missing credits

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
A quick update today to catch a few of  those pesky bugs
[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
- Fixed Milton frog soft lock
- Added collision to house
- Fixed numerous gadget bugs
- Fixed dialogue bug

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hope you're having a good time hopping! Here are some fixes that should help make your time even better!

[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
- Fixed Benjamin soft locking the game
- Fixed speed climb soft locking the game
- Fixed input for boat minigame

[h3]Gameplay improvements:[/h3]
- Improved a small number of winter climbing objects
- Modified a small number routes and climbing objects to make them easier

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
- Fixed miscellaneous visual bugs.
